_comment: Guards the target-legality rule (item 1): a targeted spell with no legal target is uncastable (CR 601.2c), even when its alt-cost would otherwise be lethal. Opp at 3 with Tainted Remedy + Forest, Invigorate in hand -- the alt-cost 3 would be exactly lethal -- BUT there is NO creature anywhere (neither player controls one), so Invigorate ('target creature') has no legal target and cannot be cast. PASS = the engine does NOT fire it and does NOT win. If this ever wins, a targetless cast has crept back in.
